narrative.details: <Penned in faded ink, the note is requesting $2oa Lesser Wizard's Robe, along with information about delivery location and payment.  At the bottom appears text denoting this writ is transferable.>
narrative.objectives: Acquire the items requested by the customer and deliver them to the location marked on your map. This writ must be in your possession to complete the transaction.
narrative.offerRewardText: <Alan speaks in a whisper.> Don't you think it is a little suspicious to be carrying elegant robes in broad daylight to a man garbed in dark leathers? Well, ahem, fortunately I am out here on behalf of the Kirin Tor, so there is no shady transaction about to take place. None at all. The robe, please.
narrative.requestItemsText: <The man stands at attention, peering over the mountainside toward Dalaran. He regards your presence with a subtle wave of a hand, beckoning you closer.>
